result.title: AM-Bench: A Unified Taxonomy and Evaluation Suite for Agentic Misalignment
result.summary: As LLM-based agents are deployed with increasing autonomy in real-world environments, a critical failure mode emerges: agentic misalignment, where agents choose harmful actions over failure. However, existing safety benchmarks primarily evaluate whether agents comply with explicitly harmful instructions, leaving the conditions that cause agents to choose harmful actions poorly understood. To address this limitation, we propose AM-Bench, a unified taxonomy and 35 scenario evaluation benchmark spanning seven industries for agentic misalignment grounded in the fraud triangle, a well-established criminological framework explaining goal-directed misconduct. We adapt this framework to agentic environments and construct our evaluation suite and detection systems along three dimensions: perceived threat, perceived opportunity, and reasoning. We operationalize each dimension into structured subcategories rooted in prior theory: five threat categories derived from the instrumental convergence thesis, seven opportunity categories drawn from the Emergent Strategic Reasoning Risks (ESRR) taxonomy, and a novel four-question binary reasoning framework synthesized from prior literature. Our evaluation of 10 frontier models reveals a 62-percentage-point gap in misalignment across scenarios, with Gemini 3 Flash and Gemini 3.1 Pro exhibiting the highest levels of agentic misalignment while Claude Sonnet 4.6 displays near-zero rates across all conditions. Our reasoning framework further reveals that models may exhibit harmful behaviours without explicit situational awareness or explanation, complicating both mitigation and detection. AM-Bench scenarios and code are available at https://github.com/AI4Collaboration/Agentic-Misalignment-Bench

AI.brief_summary: 提出 AM-Bench，基于犯罪学「欺诈三角」构建覆盖七个行业的 35 场景分类法与评测套件，从感知威胁、感知机会与推理三个维度检测 agentic misalignment，并评测 10 个前沿模型，发现场景间错位率相差 62 个百分点。
AI.relevance_reason: 与视觉或多模态推理主线无直接关联，但其「模型出现有害行为却无明确情境意识或解释」的行为—推理分离发现以及四问二元推理框架，可能为核查 latent 内容是否因果驱动输出、推理轨迹监督是否可信提供类比线索。
